description: This Java class, EmployeeDTOConverter, provides static methods to convert Employee domain objects to EmployeeDTO data transfer objects, including associated project data. It includes helper methods to extract project information from Employee objects.

classes.name: EmployeeDTOConverter
classes.description: Final utility class with static methods for converting Employee domain objects to EmployeeDTO data transfer objects, including project information.

methods.name: convertToEmployeeDTO
methods.description: Converts an Employee domain object into an EmployeeDTO, including the associated projects.

methods.name: getProjectForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a set of Projects associated with the Employee by extracting them from EmployeeProject relationships.
